page.title: Decision
page.purpose: Let the operator catch up on one decision cold, on a phone, and answer it in about a minute: read the cover, look at the attached files inside the Hub, and answer with the Hub's own form.

priorities.statement: The question, in plain words, with the big picture and the requester's recommendation, so a cold reader can decide without opening anything else.
The attached files, shown as tiles that open inside the Hub as the requester saw them, with a change marker when the original moved on.
The answer form: the requester's options (Other always available) and any typed questions, with Accept all recommended as a pre-fill the operator still sends.
What happens to the answer: sending it is deliberate, an uncertain result is never replayed, and a recorded answer offers the next waiting decision.
When the operator cannot answer yet, one tap asks the requester for more context and the page says it is waiting for the agent.

states.description: An open decision with its cover, attachments and answer form.
A question with nothing attached, no page from the requester and no typed questions: the cover and the answer form in one column, with no empty attachment or page section drawn.
An answer is on its way; the form is locked and the page then reads the decision back.
Send is unavailable until an answer is chosen, a required question is answered, or Other is explained; the reason is said next to the button.
The decision is readable while an attachment or the requester's page could not be loaded; the answer form is unaffected.
The answer could not be confirmed. The attempted answer is kept and only status can be checked.
Signed out: the decision stays readable and the form is replaced by sign-in.
The answer is recorded; the next waiting decision is offered.
The operator asked for more context and the requester has not yet updated the decision.

The requester updated the decision while the operator was answering, so nothing was sent: the revised decision is reloaded, the draft is kept, and the page says to check it against what changed before sending again.
The requester updated the decision after a question; what changed is one tap away.
The requester's default was applied; one later answer is still allowed.
Answered, expired, withdrawn or dismissed: read-only.
